newsitem.title: USA: Wildfire destroys homes and cars in California.
newsitem.headline: Wildfire destroys homes and cars in California.

text.p: A fire believed to have been started deliberately destroyed homes and vehicles in the hills near this southern Californian town, fire officials said Saturday.
The wildfire started Friday afternoon near Lake Wohlford and swept thorugh 500 acres of brush, burning down 30 homes and other buildings and destroying 30 vehicles.
California Department of Forestry chief Bill Clayton said firefighters found an incendiary device where the fire was believed to have started.
A CDF spokeswoman said the fire should be under control by Sunday morning.
A second wildfire burned 500 acres of brush 15 miles to the southeast of Escondido, threatening buildings in the Ramona area, but no damage had been reported.
